page_note: Page is dominated by ecclesial-institutional teaching about the catechumens — how their alms are received, purified, painted as icons of light, and how their recompense is reckoned. The cosmological imagery (icon of light, country of Rest, First Light) is deployed in service of the catechumen institution rather than as substrate teaching. Segments 20-23 close one kephalaion with a hagiographic dialogue frame; segment 24 is a chapter number (ϩⲃ̄ = 92); segments 25-31 open a new kephalaion with the disciples asking why the Apostle did not write the purification of the catechumens (explicit reference to the metangismos doctrine). No oldest-substrate content recoverable on this page.
